nancy-k-smith.text: As board president, voted with the 4-0 board in Feb. 2025 to renew The Palmdale Aerospace Academy charter through 2030: "I'd like to see the continued cooperation and transparency so that we can all be comfortable with both sides."

source.title: Antelope Valley Press: Five more years for TPAA (2025-02-15)

ralph-velador.text: (2024) Spoke at the Palmdale Planning Commission for the 433-acre Antelope Valley Commerce Center industrial plan, saying local jobs keep money in the community and spare residents long commutes: "These jobs are super important for us."

source.title: Antelope Valley Press: Commerce center coming to Palmdale (2025-01-03)

ralph-velador.text: Speaking as LiUNA's director of organizing, praised Lancaster's Westside annexation/industrial plan: "those are good-paying union jobs, good-benefited jobs, mortgage-paying jobs that allow these folks to go to work every day, come home and spend quality time with their family."

source.title: Antelope Valley Press: Westside annexation plan supported by commission (2025-08-30)

notes: Two incumbents in the same trustee area. Velador was absent for several reported board votes (TPAA renewal, academy appointments), so none are attributed to him. Board-wide unanimous votes (e.g., Dec. 2025 cabinet contracts) are not attributed because members aren't named. Searches used: 8.
